items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Miles was very deep and spiritual... Miles always led the way... I took 'Bitches Brew' as a joke... I hadn’t really seen a lead sheet until after I had read 'Infant Eyes' you know.

ctx.x: He was a cat, and Miles was very deep and spiritual. He didn’t use spiritual titles but his music was almost sacred you know, some of it, a great deal of it you know. And but the thing is I just want to interject while I’m thinking so I won’t forget, you know the way these interviews and conversations go it seems like the whole world revolves around black/white issues you know but they don’t you know. There’s a lot of Asian people that play good classical music and jazz you know, but that’s what we talk about in…
How do you think that conflict — is it different now?
